title: Noel Tata to exit six Tata company boards

timeline.title: Noel Tata to exit six Tata company boards
timeline.line: Leaves Trent, Titan, Tata Steel, Voltas and others around Nov 12 on turning 70
more: Bahram Vakil to chair Trent from Nov 12
Stays on Tata Sons board as Tata Trusts nominee
Comes amid reported differences with N Chandrasekaran
